panels.title: Panel
panels.description: Both probes: the container's /healthz and the public entry through Cloudflare Access.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The image running now.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the container last started (a deploy or a restart).

panels.title: LaLiga throttling
panels.description: Whether the request queue is paused after a 429.

panels.title: Requests · 24h
panels.description: Requests sent to the LaLiga API in the last 24 hours; cache hits do not count.

panels.title: 429s · 24h
panels.description: Rate-limit answers from LaLiga in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of the container.

panels.title: Median · 1h
panels.description: Half of LaLiga's answers in the last hour came faster than this (until its headers).

panels.title: p95 · 1h
panels.description: One answer in twenty in the last hour was slower than this.

panels.title: Answered OK · 24h
panels.description: Share of LaLiga's answers in the last 24 hours that were 2xx or 3xx; the rest are 4xx, 5xx or no answer.

panels.title: Slow answers · 24h
panels.description: Answers that took more than 2 seconds in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: LaLiga's answer time over 5-minute windows: median, p95 and p99.

panels.title: Answers by status
panels.description: LaLiga's answers per minute by status class; error is a request that got no answer.

panels.title: Hits · last matchday
panels.description: Share of fielded players, league-wide, who scored within 2 points of what the app forecast, on the last played matchday.

panels.title: Hits per matchday
panels.description: Share of fielded players who scored within 2 points of their forecast, by matchday.

panels.title: Average miss
panels.description: How far, on average, a player's points landed from his forecast.

panels.title: Scored vs forecast
panels.description: Points the league's elevens scored over what was forecast for them: above 100 %, the forecast fell short.

panels.title: Players compared
panels.description: Fielded players behind each matchday's numbers.

panels.title: Requests per minute
panels.description: Sent, rate-limited (429) and refused by the queue while paused or past their patience.

panels.title: World rebuilds
panels.description: How long each rebuild takes: slowest and average per interval.

targets.expr: container:laliga-fantasy _msg:"world rebuilt" | stats max(ms) slowest, avg(ms) average

panels.title: Writes by operation
panels.description: Every write that reached LaLiga, by operation: bids, offers, clauses, lineups, favourites.

targets.expr: container:laliga-fantasy _msg:in("write done","automatic write done") | stats by (operation) count() writes

panels.title: Panel use
panels.description: Requests to the panel by entry: access is the public one behind Cloudflare Access, private the tailnet.

targets.expr: container:laliga-fantasy _msg:http door:* | stats by (door) count() requests

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU used by the container, in cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of the container.

panels.title: Writes
panels.description: Done, automatic and refused writes, with the refusal's reason.

targets.expr: container:laliga-fantasy _msg:in("write done","write refused","automatic write done") | format "<_msg> · <operation> <player> <amount> <reason>" as _msg

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Everything above INFO, without the /healthz 503s while it starts.
